parsed.public_message: Blue remains stationary on the West Plateau at (255-280, 695-729). We uphold the four-way non-aggression pact through t=450 with one full turn of public notice thereafter. We will announce publicly before beginning our step down into the western lowland (x=440-500, z=640-720) ahead of the t=300 ring contraction.

private_messages.Claude: We have kept all units consolidated on the West Plateau and sent no scouts out, so we have no direct sight of the Central Heights—only earlier shared reports placing 4x White Odrysian cavalry near (658,825) with White's main body further back on the hill. What does your rider at (648,566) currently see near the centre or toward Green around (680,630)? We will give clear notice before stepping down into x=440-500, z=640-720.
private_messages.Grok: Confirmed, Blue remains stationary on the West Plateau this turn and upholds the pact through t=450. As the ring approaches 420m around t=275-300, we will announce before stepping down into the western lowland (x=440-500, z=640-720), staying clear of the Central Heights.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 10 (t=225s): Ring shrinks 660m -> 580m at t=250s, then 500m at t=275s, 420m at t=300s. Our squads on West Plateau are at dist 364-393m. Plan to announce at t=250s and begin orderly descent at t=275s into western lowland (x=440-500, z=640-720), staying north of z=620 (away from Orange on Little Hill) and west of x=500 (away from White's planned descent corridor x=520-660). Known positions: Green main army near (680,630) & scout at (780,830); Orange scout at (648,566) & main army on Little Hill south of z=600; White 4x Odrysian cav near (658,825) & main army on Central Heights.
parsed.explanation: With the ring of fire still comfortably outside the West Plateau (shrinking to 580m at t=250s while our army sits at 364-393m from the centre), we hold our fortified high ground for another turn. Meanwhile, we maintain the four-way diplomatic truce and trade intelligence with Claude and Grok to keep our upcoming descent into the western lowland friction-free.
